method: Actual original AS2 slider pointer drags in Ruffle, with private EnterFrame Trace observation. All 125 inventoried candidates in 71 files were reached, including unnamed clips, runtime duplicates and a stage-gated experiment with real next buttons and original timers. Boundary level values only; interior settings, downstream physical effects and all AS3 controls are not asserted. Raw nominal mismatches are retained and source boundary rules are separately reviewed.

endpoints.sourceBoundaryReason: Original track width is 404, with a right drag limit of 401; the /400 conversion and nearest-five rounding yield 4010. This is an observed source boundary artifact, not nominal-range agreement.

Original drag limits give knob x=0.95 and 200.85. Level is min + round(knobX/200*range*50)/50, yielding 0.42 and 3.02. The stage-4 slider was reached with real next buttons and original ten-second timers; its individual HTML migration remains pending.
